instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with yoga mats stacked on a wall rack, the older dancer in a beige camisole and shorts (R4) stands behind the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts (R5). The older dancer supports the blonde girl by holding her raised right ankle and placing her other hand on her back to adjust her posture. The blonde girl balances on one leg in a high side-leg extension, looking to the right. Bright, even daylight fills the clean space, emphasizing the neutral beige and white palette.
